architecture.question: For PDP-11/70 virtual physical architecture, distinguish 16-bit virtual addresses from 22-bit physical addresses in at most 45 words. Cite the supplied reference.
architecture.answer: The PDP-11/70 uses 16-bit virtual addresses (64 KiB) per address space, which the memory-management unit translates to 22-bit physical addresses spanning 4 MiB [ref:1170-addresses]. Separate instruction/data spaces do not increase the virtual address width beyond 16 bits.
